run_note: second attempt. The first (CBGG4HOE...) proved every lane fact but died on this tool's own readback assertion — program_root was compared against the end root, a reader bug exposed by the detail line printing correct stored bytes; per the rule the merged-v1 receipt already established, the flow was re-run whole with a fixed reader rather than hand-correcting a receipt. Both registries are live and frozen; this record supersedes that one as the showcase.
